==Signing up== To register for any of the 3 official tournaments, you need to sign up at the signup booth. Sign ups open on Wednesday (day 1), and the deadline for sign ups is 60 minutes prior to the start of each respective tournament. =====Clean Language requirement===== We enforce a Clean Language rule for team names. Please avoid using sexual or in other ways inappropriate language, as the event will be broadcasted to a wider audience than the local community. This of course applies to nickname switching or any other variations of trying to be funny. If you don't follow these simple rules, you may be removed from the tournament. ==Tournament system== * The 1on1, 2on2 and 4on4 tournaments consist of two stages: ** A round-robin group stage. ** A single elimination playoff. * The participants that end up first and second in their group go to the playoffs. * The playoffs will have a 3rd place match. * Group stage matches are BO3. * The 1on1 and 2on2 playoff matches are BO5, except the finals which are BO7. * The 4on4 playoff matches are BO3, except the final which is BO5. ==Points== The ranking in the group stage is determined by taking the following stats into account (in order): * Points (1 point per match win). * Map difference. * Internal fight. * Map difference in those internal fights. * Frag difference in those internal fights. * Total frag difference of all games. ==Match procedure== ===BO3=== * TB3 (4on4 group stage and playoffs except final) ** The procedure is "''pick-pick-play''". ** The participant that wins "/cmd rnd participant1 participant2" picks first. * TB5+2 (1on1, 2on2 group stage) ** The procedure is "''toss-toss-toss-toss-pick-pick-play''". ** The participant that wins "/cmd rnd participant1 participant2" tosses first and picks first like so: *** Participant1 ''tosses'' map1. *** Participant2 ''tosses'' map2 and map3 *** Participant1 ''tosses'' map4 *** Participant1 ''picks'' playmap1 *** Participant2 ''picks'' playmap2 *** If necessary, the last remaining map is played. * The participant that wins 2 maps first, wins. ===BO5=== * TB3 (4on4 final) ** The procedure is "''pick-pick-play-pick-pick''". ** The participant that wins "/cmd rnd participant1 participant2" picks first. ** All maps must be played once in the first 3 maps. ** If the match is not won after 3 maps have been played, the participant that picked the first map, picks the next map. ** If the match goes to 5 maps, the other participant picks the last map. The last map cannot be repeated without agreement from the opponent. * TB5+2 (1on1, 2on2 playoffs, except finals) ** The procedure is "''toss-toss-pick-pick-pick-pick-play''". ** The participant that wins "/cmd rnd participant1 participant2" tosses first and picks first. * The participant that wins 3 maps first, wins. ===BO7=== * TB5+2 (1on1, 2on2 finals) ** The procedure is "''pick-pick-pick-pick-pick-pick-play''". ** The participant that wins "/cmd rnd participant1 participant2" picks first. * The participant that wins 4 maps first, wins. ==Server Settings== * Timelimit: ** 20 minutes in 4on4 with 5 minutes of overtime ** 10 minutes in 1on1 and 2on2 with 3 minutes of overtime * Deathmatch mode: ** dmm1 in 4on4 ** dmm3 in 1on1 and 2on2 * Teamplay mode: 2 * Spawn mode: KTX2 * Powerups: Default * Discharge: ON * Fallbunny: ON * Teamoverlay: OFF * Antilag: 2 * No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes. * If a team/player requests /nospecs, the opponent is obliged to comply. ==Client Settings == * Allowed clients: EzQuake 3.6 or later * Allowed ruleset: smackdown, qcon ==Match Reporting== * The team/player that wins has to report the match in the #match-reporting channel on the QHLAN Discord. * A report consists of screenshots and server-side MVDs. ** Use match_auto_sshot 1 to automatically save screenshots of played games. == Signup Information == * Maximum number of attendees is 95 * Signing up on [http://qhlan.org qhlan.org] is seen as a declaration of interest * The "CERTAINTY" value (0-100%) of your sign-up is just an indicator, and doesn't help your application in any way * '''Prepay to secure your seat''' ** Payment information can be found on [http://qhlan.org qhlan.org] ** First come, first served ** Once your payment is processed, your status will change to "Paid". == Entrance fee == Players choose any of the three event packages.
